tasks.subject: Task 1: Parameterise Movy row cell geometry
tasks.description:
**Goal:** render_page_movy.mjs can draw a knob row at any origin and cell width, and its default output is byte-identical to before.

**Files:**
- Modify: src/shared/param_pages/render_page_movy.mjs
- Create: tests/host/test_knob_card.sh
- Create: tests/fixtures/movy-geom-baseline.json

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] drawKnobStrip exported taking {x0, cellW}
- [ ] GRID_GEOM exported as {x0:0, cellW:CELL_W}
- [ ] renderPageMovy byte-identical against pre-refactor baseline for every fixture page
- [ ] non-default geometry moves the cells
- [ ] clipped()===0 and no missing glyphs for both geometries

**Verify:** bash tests/host/test_knob_card.sh && bash tests/host/test_param_pages_movy.sh && bash tests/host/test_param_pages_render.sh && bash tests/host/test_param_pages_viz.sh

**Steps:** see docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-20-chain-knob-card.md

tasks.subject: Task 2: The knob card renderer
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A pure knob_card.mjs that draws the frame and the strip, with the black gap between border and header band asserted on the pixel buffer.

**Files:**
- Create: src/shared/param_pages/knob_card.mjs
- Modify: tests/host/test_knob_card.sh

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] knobCardRect(true) is {x:3,y:12,w:122,h:38} and knobCardRect(false) is {x:3,y:24,w:122,h:15}
- [ ] gap row/column inside the border is black for both heights with every knob touched in turn
- [ ] border pixels are present
- [ ] content 116px wide, cells 29px
- [ ] clipped()===0 and no missing glyphs across float/int/enum/opaque/short
- [ ] long name truncates but the value survives

**Verify:** bash tests/host/test_knob_card.sh

**Steps:** see docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-20-chain-knob-card.md


tasks.subject: Task 3: Preview the card without a deploy
tasks.description:
**Goal:** preview_knob_card.mjs renders the card over a real chain diagram, so the frame can be judged from a PNG.

**Files:**
- Create: tools/param-pages/preview_knob_card.mjs

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] half-block art by default, PNG with --png/--scale
- [ ] background is the real chain diagram plus real header and footer
- [ ] --knob N and --short both work
- [ ] clipped=0 reported for all eight knobs and the short card

**Verify:** for k in 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7; do node tools/param-pages/preview_knob_card.mjs obxd --knob $k | tail -1; done; node tools/param-pages/preview_knob_card.mjs --short | tail -1

**Steps:** see docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-20-chain-knob-card.md

```json:metadata
{"files":["tools/param-pages/preview_knob_card.mjs"],"verifyCommand":"for k in 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7; do node tools/param-pages/preview_knob_card.mjs obxd --knob $k | tail -1; done; node tools/param-pages/preview_knob_card.mjs --short | tail -1","acceptanceCriteria":["half-block art by default, PNG with --png/--scale","background is the real chain diagram plus real header and footer","--knob N and --short both work","clipped=0 reported for all eight knobs and the short card"],"modelTier":"mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Wire the card into the chain editor
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Touching a knob in VIEWS.CHAIN_EDIT raises the card; releasing drops it; no IPC happens on the draw path.

**Files:**
- Modify: src/shadow/shadow_ui.js

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] touch raises the card with the touched knob row, its cell inverted
- [ ] release drops it; a turn with no touch decays after ~700ms
- [ ] no component selected gives the short header-only card
- [ ] screen reader announces only on content change
- [ ] leaving CHAIN_EDIT closes the card
- [ ] HIERARCHY_EDITOR and the Zoom overlays are unchanged

**Verify:** bash tests/host/test_chain_edit_read_budget.sh && bash tests/host/test_param_pages_wiring.sh && bash tests/host/test_chain_gestures.sh

**Steps:** see docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-20-chain-knob-card.md

```json:metadata
{"files":["src/shadow/shadow_ui.js"],"verifyCommand":"bash tests/host/test_chain_edit_read_budget.sh && bash tests/host/test_param_pages_wiring.sh && bash tests/host/test_chain_gestures.sh","acceptanceCriteria":["touch raises the card with the touched knob row, its cell inverted","release drops it; a turn with no touch decays after ~700ms","no component selected gives the short header-only card","screen reader announces only on content change","leaving CHAIN_EDIT closes the card","HIERARCHY_EDITOR and the Zoom overlays are unchanged"],"modelTier":"standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Prove the card costs no IPC per frame
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A test that fails if drawing the card ever reads a parameter.

**Files:**
- Create: tests/host/test_chain_knob_card_reads.sh

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] knob_card.mjs holds no param I/O identifiers
- [ ] 60 renders issue zero reads through the ctx stubs and the values Proxy
- [ ] the test demonstrably fails when a read is introduced

**Verify:** bash tests/host/test_chain_knob_card_reads.sh

**Steps:** see docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-20-chain-knob-card.md
